br.br:
1. (Currently Amended) A filter covering for a sterile container lid, for completely covering at least one gas exchange portion, which is provided on a lid component of the sterile container lid, on an outside of the sterile container lid, wherein the filter covering defining extends in a main plane, and comprising the filter covering comprises:
at least two clip portions arranged opposite to each other on the filter covering, which ,
wherein the at least two clip portions are adapted to engage in a form-fitting manner in at least two clip receiving portions provided on the lid component, and by which the filter covering is mountable to and dismountable from the lid component without tools, andthe filter covering being a plate having a height, a length extending in the main plane and a width extending in the main plane, wherein the height is less than the length and less than the width,
wherein the at least two clip portions being areformed as portions extending from the plate and bent away from the main plane in a bracket- or a C-shaped manner,
wherein in a sectional view of the filter covering viewed along the main plane in which the at least two clip portions are provided, an entire section of the filter covering except for the at least two clip portions extends in the main plane, and the at least two clip portions bend away from the main plane in the bracket- or C-shaped manner such that respective ends of the clip portions face each other such that said respective ends of the clip portions are located closer to each other than respective portions of the two clip portions adjacent the ends.
2. (Original) The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein the filter covering is made of a plastic material in one piece.
3. (Original) The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein the at least two clip portions are arranged on opposite sides and/or ends of the filter covering.
4. (Original) The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein the at least two clip portions are positioned to engage in the at least two clip receiving portions on opposite sides and/or ends of the lid component.
5. (Original) The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein the filter covering is a rectangular plate.
6. (Original) The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein the at least two clip portions consist of exactly two clip portions.
7. (Original) The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein the filter covering is rectangular with a first side, a second side opposite the first side, a third side, and a fourth side opposite the third side, the at least two clip portions being provided on the first side and the second side.
8. (Original) The filter covering according to claim 7, wherein the at least two clip portions are not provided on the third side and the fourth side.
9. (Original) The filter covering according to claim 7, wherein the first side and the second side are shorter than the third side and the fourth side, respectively, and
wherein the first side and the second side each comprise one of the at least two clip portions.
10. (Original) The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein the at least two clip portions are configured to be clipped onto the at least two clip receiving portions.
11. (Original) The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein each of the at least two clip portions is a bracket-shaped side portion of the filter covering, and each bracket-shaped side portion comprises a laterally outwardly projecting grip portion, the laterally outwardly projecting
grip portions being manually operable when the filter covering is mounted to and dismounted from the lid component of the sterile container lid.
12. (Original) The filter covering according to claim 11, wherein each laterally outwardly projecting grip portion extends parallel to the main plane.
13. (Original) The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein the filter covering is made from amorphous thermoplastic and is transparent for visually inspecting a filter device arranged on a lid inner side of a gas exchange portion.
14. (Original) The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein the filter covering is at least partially transparent.
15. (Original) The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein the filter covering is an injection-molded part.
16. (Original) The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein the filter covering is elastically bendable.
17. (New) The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein each of said respective ends of the clip portions is a clip portion end having a maximum distance from the main plane.
18. (New) The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein a "C" is formed between each of said respective ends of the clip portions and the main plane in the sectional view.
19. (New) The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein each of said respective ends of the clip portions ends at a downward angle extending away from the main plane.
20. (New) The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein the plate extends in the main plane from a first edge at which a first one of the at least two clip portions is located to a second edge at which a second one of the at least two clip portions is located, and an entirety of the filter covering between the first edge and the second edge extends in the main plane.
